blocks.text: Rockets apne peechhe ke engines se jalti gas phenk kar chalte hain. Jala hua eendhan zyada dabao wali gas banta hai jo rocket engines se intehai tez velocity se phenki jati hai (Fig. 2.18). Rocket engine se phenki gas ke momentum ke barabar momentum pata hai magar ulti simt mein. Rocket engines rocket ke chalne ke baad bhi gasein phenkte rehte hain, to rocket zyada se zyada momentum pata rehta hai; ek jaisi speed se chalne ke bajaye jab tak engines chalein rocket tez se tez hota jata hai. Combustion chamber mein eendhan aur oxygen milte hain, garam gasein chamber se bohat tez velocity se nikalti hain, gason ke momentum ka hasil rocket ke momentum ke hasil ke barabar hai, aur gas aur rocket ek doosre ko dhakka de kar ulti simton mein chalte hain.

Rocket apna eendhan liquid ya solid hydrogen aur oxygen ki shakal mein saath rakhta hai, to yeh bohat oonchai par kaam kar sakta hai jahan bohat kam ya koi hawa nahi. Gravity par qaboo pane ke liye kafi oopar ka dhakka dene ko aam rocket taqreeban 10 000 kg s^-1 eendhan jalata hai aur jali gasein 4000 m s^-1 se zyada ki speed se phenkta hai; dar asal rocket ke launch mass ka 80% se zyada sirf eendhan hota hai. Eendhan ke mass ke masle par qaboo pane ka ek tareeqa rocket ko kai jure hue rockets se banana hai: jab ek rocket apna kaam kar chuke to use alag kar diya jata hai, baqi spacecraft ko aur oopar aur zyada speed se le jate hain.

blocks.title: Rocket ka acceleration
blocks.text: Agar m har second rocket ki nisbat velocity v se phenki gason ka mass ho to phenki gason ke momentum ki har second tabdeeli mv hai. Yeh rocket ke jism par engine ke paida kiye dhakke (thrust) ke barabar hai, to rocket ka acceleration a = mv/M ... (2.42, jaisa chhapa) hai, jahan M rocket ka mass hai. Jaise eendhan jal kar phenka jata hai rocket ka mass M ghatta hai aur is liye acceleration barhta hai.

blocks.prompt: 2.0 x 10^5 kg ka rocket 5.0 x 10^3 kg s^-1 gas rocket ki nisbat 4000 m s^-1 ki speed se phenkta hai. Thrust aur ibtidai acceleration nikalein, aur batayein ke eendhan jalne par acceleration ka kya hota hai.
blocks.explanation: Thrust = mv = 5.0 x 10^3 kg s^-1 x 4000 m s^-1 = 2.0 x 10^7 N; a = mv/M = 2.0 x 10^7 N / 2.0 x 10^5 kg = 100 m s^-2 (gravity nazar andaz; gravity ke saath oopar ka khalis acceleration taqreeban 90 m s^-2). Eendhan phenkne par M ghatta hai jabke mv wahi rehta hai, to acceleration barhta hai.

items: Rocket phenki gas ke barabar aur ulta momentum pata hai; engines chalne tak tez hota rehta hai. Hydrogen aur oxygen saath, taqreeban 10 000 kg s^-1 jalata, 4000 m s^-1 se zyada par phenkta, 80% se zyada eendhan, hisson mein bana.
a = mv/M: m = har second phenka mass, v = rocket ki nisbat gas ki velocity, mv = thrust, M = rocket ka mass (eendhan jalne par ghatta, to a barhta).
